I have to ask one question. 0:20:38.550 --> 0:20:41.590 Last follow-up on this because it's always something that just 0:20:41.609 --> 0:20:44.470 the process and the craft of it is so interesting 0:20:44.510 --> 0:20:44.810 to me. 0:20:45.630 --> 0:20:48.270 What is one thing that, you know, as an. 0:20:48.350 --> 0:20:52.649 Absolute truth about the craft of playing receiver in the 0:20:52.710 --> 0:20:55.910 NFL at this level that you don't think fans maybe 0:20:55.970 --> 0:20:59.620 notice or something small, like technical thing that you think 0:21:00.660 --> 0:21:02.840 you really focus on or your guys really focus on 0:21:02.880 --> 0:21:04.919 that you don't think maybe is as visible to the 0:21:04.960 --> 0:21:05.510 public eye. 0:21:06.010 --> 0:21:09.510 First and foremost, what people don't realize is that I 0:21:09.530 --> 0:21:12.890 don't think they realize that both receivers are all three 0:21:12.910 --> 0:21:18.400 receivers work together in a concept.
